action: I step out where Captain Ilyra Venn can see me. I tell her I heard everything. I will carry copies of the orders to the public book, but I will not promise to protect her from what follows. I ask her to give me the evidence and tell me whether breaking the void also freed the strangers from the tune.

marks.text: You were poisoned; your next save against poison has disadvantage.

fronts.danger: a blight or plague is spreading toward the town

recentLedger.text: ◆ The shared three-note tune was being used as a command key to feed stolen voices into an expanding void; Captain Ilyra Venn permanently broke its mechanism and renounced the guard conspiracy.

fields.permanentChange: She broke the void mechanism, renounced the guard conspiracy, and committed to putting its orders in the public record.

dm.truth: Venn helped operate the command-key void until the courier report made her understand that the victims’ stolen voices were feeding it.
dm.want: survive long enough to publish every order

skin.text: A specific song is being hummed by strangers who've never met. — The same unfamiliar tune, unconsciously, by people across the district who can't say where they learned it.
